nodes.text: Big Sal wipes coal dust off a glass that somehow gets dirtier. The boys need work, protection, and someone else to pay for both. What are you offering?

options.text: Buy a round for the crew. (-$75, +Trust)
Ask where the unsafe tunnels really are. (+Influence)

nodes.text: Sal grins. A generous prospector is still a prospector, but the crew will remember the tab.
Sal marks three spots on a napkin. None of them are on the official maps. Naturally.
